s: Who was the first Telugu woman to offer her jewellery to the "Tilak Swarajya Fund" and burn foreign clothes?
x:
Maganti Annapurnamma was the first Telugu woman to donate her jewellery to the Tilak Swarajya Fund launched by Mahatma Gandhi during the Non-Cooperation Movement. She also publicly burnt foreign clothes, setting an example for women to participate actively in the national movement. Her sacrifice inspired many women in Andhra to join the freedom struggle.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).
n: First Telugu Woman to donate jewellery to Tilak Swarajya Fund – Maganti Annapurnamma
